cohort: 225 women with a history of Cesarean section who were examined 6-12 months postpartum.
finding: The prevalence of a niche was 24.0%, and a niche, particularly its volume, was significantly associated with postmenstrual spotting.
mod_finding: The presence of a niche, a sequela of Cesarean section, was associated with an increased incidence of postmenstrual spotting.
